thread:
Lena Morris: quick heads-up — we need a concise external update & account outreach for customers hit by yesterday's routing fallback. Affected list attached in the doc.
Darren Cho: thanks. do we have a recommended credit amount or SLA note? legal asked to avoid promises beyond the SLA.
Priya Patel: recommend a goodwill credit + 1:1 enablement session offer. suggest 10% credit for the billing period and a 30-min walkthrough with our solutions engineer. keeps expectations conservative. :thumbsup:
Tomás Rivera: can we segment by impact severity? e.g., timeouts for high-throughput vs momentary latency spikes. credits tiered 10/5/0.
Lena Morris: yes — doc has severity flags: P1 (>=30m outage) P2 (repeated 5-30m) P3 (single short spike). propose 10%/5%/offer-only for P1/P2/P3.
Anita Singh: billing okay w/ that range. need the final list with customer billing contacts and contract tier by EOD to process credits next week.
Priya Patel: drafting the customer note now — short and transparent. putting the key points below, feedback pls: 
ops-bot: New doc created: https://redwood.docs/incident/1981234567-impact-list (shared with cs/sales/legal)
Lena Morris: paste draft here please.
Priya Patel: ```
Hi <Customer>,

We’re reaching out about an incident on <date> that affected inference routing for a subset of requests. You may have seen increased latency or transient 5xx responses during a short window. Our engineering team implemented a routing fix and validated model fallbacks.

What we’re doing:
- Root cause: an interaction between our smart routing heuristics and a rare node-to-node KV cache eviction pattern.
- Fixes: deployed routing policy tweak + cache hardening; long-term patch in progress.
- Customer impact: short windows of degraded responses; no data exfiltration.
- Compensation: we’re issuing a billing credit of X% for impacted billing period(s) and offering a 1:1 enablement session to review best practices for high-throughput requests.

If you’d like a tailored follow-up, reply and we’ll schedule.

Thanks,
Redwood Inference Customer Success
```
Darren Cho: looks good. swap X% with the tiered amounts we decided. add a link to the status page and an opt-out for a call (some prefer just credit).
Tomás Rivera: add one sentence on signal monitoring improvements and an ETA for the long-term fix (estimating 2 weeks), so customers know we’re tracking it.
Anita Singh: confirm the credit text reads: "A billing credit of 10% (P1) / 5% (P2) / a complimentary enablement session (P3) will be applied where applicable." Billing will need csv of account ids + tier.
Priya Patel: noted. I’ll update draft and tag legal for a quick read. plan to send initial outbound at 10:00 PT tomorrow after legal ok.
Lena Morris: ops, please queue a targeted support email template and add a post-send survey link for feedback capture. we want to capture whether they noticed impact and if the credit amount is acceptable.
ops-bot: Email template queued in Intercom: Incident-1981234567-cs-template. Post-send survey draft available at https://redwood.docs/surveys/1981234567-survey
Darren Cho: who owns the 1:1 scheduling? Solutions eng / enablement?
Priya Patel: I’ll coordinate scheduling with SEs; include a Calendly link in the email for convenience.
Tomás Rivera: flagging renewal-risk accounts in the doc — @Lena Morris, can CS lead reach out personally for top 10 accounts? I can provide technical notes for the call.
Lena Morris: yes — I’ll set up 1:1s for the top 10. Priya, add a personal outreach template for renewals.
Anita Singh: once credits are approved, billing will post them next invoice cycle. tell customers it may take one billing cycle to appear.
Priya Patel: final checklist before send: updated draft (done), legal review (requested), billing csv (Anita), top-10 outreach owners assigned (Lena), survey link (ops). aiming 10:00 PT.
Lena Morris: thanks team. small ask — capture any customer replies in the doc thread and tag me. we’ll track sentiment and churn risk.
Darren Cho: will monitor replies and escalate any flagged renewal concerns.
ops-bot: Reminder set: send outbound at 10:00 PT 1981238200.
Priya Patel: sending to legal now. will post final copy here when approved.
Lena Morris: appreciate the quick turnaround. :pray:
